MGMT 250.description: Theory and practice of oral and written communication skills required in the contemporary business environment.
MGMT 250.subject: MGMT
MGMT 250.title: Professional Communication

MGMT 371.description: A comprehensive survey of the basic principles of management applicable to all forms of business. The course provides the student with a basis for thinking about complex business situations in the framework of analysis of the management process.
MGMT 371.subject: MGMT
MGMT 371.title: Principles of Management

MGMT 373.description: A study of central issues in entrepreneurship with grounding in the entrepreneurial process. The course emphasizes the creation, recognition, and assessment of entrepreneurial opportunities, as well as the role of business models and resources in enabling the pursuit of such opportunities.
MGMT 373.subject: MGMT
MGMT 373.title: Entrepreneurship and New Venture Opportunities

MGMT 374.description: A survey of the major approaches used in managing human resources. Covers selection, compensation, legal compliance, discipline, organizational restructuring, TQM, motivation, labor relations, and performance management.
MGMT 374.subject: MGMT
MGMT 374.title: Strategic Human Resource Management

MGMT 376.description: Introduction to human behavior in organizations. Emphasis on factors that contribute to the effectiveness of individuals and groups in organizations.
MGMT 376.subject: MGMT
MGMT 376.title: Employee Engagement

MGMT 401.description: This course is designed to improve students' knowledge and skills in the areas of workplace conflict resolution and negotiations.
MGMT 401.subject: MGMT
MGMT 401.title: Negotiation and Conflict in the Workplace

MGMT 402.description: Team dynamics in organizational settings; basic concepts of interpersonal behavior, how to facilitate effective teamwork and create, motivate, and participate in effective teams based on concepts in team design and team process.
MGMT 402.subject: MGMT
MGMT 402.title: Managing Teams in the Workplace

MGMT 403.description: Reviews research and practice in organizational leadership; provides students with self-assessment, developmental exercises, and case studies to prepare students for leadership roles.
MGMT 403.subject: MGMT
MGMT 403.title: Leadership in Organizations

MGMT 404.description: An examination of how organizations use pay and other types of rewards (both intrinsic and extrinsic) to affect employee motivation and behavior.
MGMT 404.subject: MGMT
MGMT 404.title: Compensation and Retention

MGMT 405.description: An examination of how organizations can improve workforce quality by making effective use of recruiting and selection processes. Attention is also given to the training and development of new hires and to legal issues that surround the staffing process.
MGMT 405.subject: MGMT
MGMT 405.title: Talent Management

MGMT 406.description: This course examines how human resources are managed within a global context. It examines how human resources are managed within global firms as well as across different cultural settings.
MGMT 406.subject: MGMT
MGMT 406.title: International Human Resource Management

MGMT 407.description: This course examines the role of corporate social responsibility in managing organizations. Attention is given to the role of stakeholder management and ethics in organizational decision-making.
MGMT 407.subject: MGMT
MGMT 407.title: Corporate Social Responsibility and Stakeholder Management

MGMT 408.description: Principles and practices of managing a dynamic and complex workforce in today’s global business environment. Topics to include: leadership, team dynamics, communication, motivation, conflict resolution, and organizational culture.
MGMT 408.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MGMT 371.
MGMT 408.subject: MGMT
MGMT 408.title: Managing Today's Global Workforce

MGMT 425.description: Metrics and measurements of HR concepts; processes through which knowledge is gained; tools and techniques for gathering and analyzing data; and critical thinking centered on whether findings are likely to be reproducible and trustworthy.
MGMT 425.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in both MGMT 371 and MGSC 291.
MGMT 425.subject: MGMT
MGMT 425.title: Analytics for the Human Resources Professional

MGMT 431.description: How to recruit, lead, and collaborate more effectively in international teams by examining differences related to culture, work-values, economic climate, and career progression.
MGMT 431.subject: MGMT
MGMT 431.title: Intercultural Competencies for Working in International Teams

MGMT 473.description: Explore business models and paths to commercialization for new ventures and concepts through experimentation; investigate strategies to develop and validate the business model; identify the resources needed to launch the venture and methods for acquiring those resources.
MGMT 473.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MGMT 373.
MGMT 473.subject: MGMT
MGMT 473.title: Developing and Launching New Ventures

MGMT 474.description: Influencing the performance of new ventures through the strategies, metrics, and resources needed for their development, monitoring, and funding.
MGMT 474.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MGMT 473.
MGMT 474.subject: MGMT
MGMT 474.title: Executing Strategy in New Ventures

MGMT 476.description: Practice and structure of collective bargaining, and administration of collective agreements, law of union-management relations, labor history, and bargaining theory and practice.
MGMT 476.subject: MGMT
MGMT 476.title: Collective Bargaining

MGMT 478.description: A study of the formulation and application of functionally integrated business policy by top management. Emphasis is on decision making in the face of changing conditions.
MGMT 478.subject: MGMT
MGMT 478.title: Strategic Management

MGMT 479.description: Through immersive projects, students apply entrepreneurial concepts, tools, and frameworks to advance a new or established venture.
MGMT 479.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MGMT 473.
MGMT 479.subject: MGMT
MGMT 479.title: Applications in Entrepreneurship and New Ventures

MGMT 490.description: Current topics, issues and practices in various areas of Management. Course may be repeated up to three (3) times as content varies by title.
MGMT 490.subject: MGMT
MGMT 490.title: Special Topics in Management

MGMT 499.description: Supervised work experience as approved by department. Generally three hours of academic credit, but upon special request of supervising professor and approval of appropriate area director, an internship may carry a maximum of six hours credit, however, only three hours may apply towards major credit. Pass-Fail only. Internship contract required.
MGMT 499.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Completion of DMSB core curriculum except MGMT 478, plus at least one additional course in the student’s major field of study. Cumulative GPA of 2.75 or consent of instructor.
MGMT 499.subject: MGMT
MGMT 499.title: Business Internship in Management

MGMT 590.description: Current topics, issues and practices in various areas of Management. Course may be repeated up to four (4) times as content varies by title.
MGMT 590.subject: MGMT
MGMT 590.title: Special Topics in Management

MGMT 701.description: An analysis of human resources practices viewed from a comparative, cross-national perspective and the perspective of a multinational enterprise.
MGMT 701.subject: MGMT
MGMT 701.title: Human Resources and the Global Firm

MGMT 718.description: The processes inherent in effective management of the organization's human resources. Topics include: employee selection, training, and development; design of compensation and reward systems; applied motivation models; and current issues in the management of human resources.
MGMT 718.subject: MGMT
MGMT 718.title: Management of Human Resources

MGMT 719.description: Examines the techniques, policies, processes, strategies, and practices used by companies, managers, and individuals to effectively and efficiently motivate behavior via rewards.
MGMT 719.subject: MGMT
MGMT 719.title: Management of Compensation

MGMT 720.description: Topics in staffing on a rotating basis among job analysis, recruitment, test validation, selection systems, and other subjects.
MGMT 720.subject: MGMT
MGMT 720.title: Staffing

MGMT 721.description: The law of employment relations. Policy and practice in areas such as equal employment, wages and hours, employee health and safety, pensions, and labor relations.
MGMT 721.subject: MGMT
MGMT 721.title: Employment Relations Law

MGMT 722.description: An analysis of some of the major problems faced by managers in their dealings with organizations representing employees. Primary emphasis is on the negotiation of labor agreements and the handling of problems arising under them. The public policy aspect of these problems is also considered.
MGMT 722.subject: MGMT
MGMT 722.title: Labor Relations

MGMT 723.description: Rights of employees in relation to their employers that arise from individual and collective agreements. Employee discipline and justice. Grievance procedures and their administration, including labor arbitration.
MGMT 723.subject: MGMT
MGMT 723.title: Employee Responsibilities and Rights

MGMT 724.description: The nature, structure, and development of the labor union in the United States. Topics covered include labor history, structure of the labor movement, union governance, the law of unions, and problems of the labor movement.
MGMT 724.subject: MGMT
MGMT 724.title: American Labor Unions

MGMT 725.description: Applied data analysis and research methods in human resources. Emphasis on research design, analytic strategies, measurement of human resource variables and outcomes, and presentation of written and oral information.
MGMT 725.subject: MGMT
MGMT 725.title: Human Resource Metrics and Research

MGMT 726.description: Capstone course for master’s students in human resources. integration of course work through analysis of current management issues and the use of case analysis and business simulations.
MGMT 726.subject: MGMT
MGMT 726.title: Human Resource and Business Strategy

MGMT 727.description: Field experience in human resources. Includes a report analyzing the experience.
MGMT 727.subject: MGMT
MGMT 727.title: Internship or Practicum in Human Resources

MGMT 728.description: When to use teams; how to design and implement team structures and motivate and lead team members; team decision making, conflict resolution, and other team processes.
MGMT 728.subject: MGMT
MGMT 728.title: Teams and Teamwork Management

MGMT 729.description: How the presence of members from multiple national cultures and multiple national locations affect the functioning of teams within the multinational corporation.
MGMT 729.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: DMSB 714 or IBUS 700 or MGMT 770 or MGMT 799.
MGMT 729.subject: MGMT
MGMT 729.title: Managing Cross-border Teams

MGMT 730.description: Restructuring and transformation initiatives within multinational organizations as internal consultants and/or change agents.
MGMT 730.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: DMSB 711 or IBUS 700 or MGMT 779.
MGMT 730.subject: MGMT
MGMT 730.title: Consulting and Organizational Development in MNCs

MGMT 731.description: Negotiations analysis, thinking, and communication; alignment between negotiation objectives and strategies; negotiation skills.
MGMT 731.subject: MGMT
MGMT 731.title: Negotiations

MGMT 732.description: Experiential learning with successful business leaders; diagnosis of specific contexts and issues of leadership within these contexts; integration and comparison of leadership across contexts.
MGMT 732.subject: MGMT
MGMT 732.title: Learning with Leaders

MGMT 733.description: Understanding and managing innovation, both sustaining and disruptive; creating new capabilities in new entrepreneurial firms or large corporations.
MGMT 733.subject: MGMT
MGMT 733.title: Strategic Management of Technology and Innovation

MGMT 735.description: Mergers and acquisitions in international and domestic settings: effects of strategic, financial, legal, accounting, and human resource factors.
MGMT 735.subject: MGMT
MGMT 735.title: Mergers and Acquisitions

MGMT 737.description: Provides an applied Human Resources experiential project where students work under close faculty supervision to solve real-world business challenges using applied research and analytical skills.
MGMT 737.subject: MGMT
MGMT 737.title: Human Resources Experiential Project

MGMT 748.description: Accounting, economics, finance, marketing, production, and international environment integrated for the analysis of management problems. Oral and written communications using the case method.
MGMT 748.subject: MGMT
MGMT 748.title: Strategic Management

MGMT 750.description: Fundamentals of analysis and decision-making in financial management for human resource professionals.
MGMT 750.subject: MGMT
MGMT 750.title: Finance for Human Resource Professionals

MGMT 770.description: Development of an understanding of behavioral concepts necessary for effective production management of organizations. Current literature, case studies, and other simulations to demonstrate applicability of concepts. Concepts studies include perception, motivation, leadership, and intergroup conflict.
MGMT 770.subject: MGMT
MGMT 770.title: Organizational Behavior

MGMT 771.description: A study of the nature of organizations, their design, their structure, their processes, as well as problems inherent in organizations (e.g., coordination, conflict, communications, power usage, politics).
MGMT 771.subject: MGMT
MGMT 771.title: Organization Theory and Design

MGMT 772.description: Examination of methods of employee development and leadership development with an emphasis given to program design, management, and evaluation.
MGMT 772.subject: MGMT
MGMT 772.title: Employee and Leadership Development

MGMT 773.description: Policy formulation and decision-making in organizations. The interrelationships of functional areas within the organization, the application of management skills and processes to integrate these areas, and the impact of factors external to the organization are examined with a view toward the attainment of organizational goals.
MGMT 773.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: MKTG 751, FINA 760, MGMT 770, and MGSC 791.
MGMT 773.subject: MGMT
MGMT 773.title: Business Policy

MGMT 774.description: The forces which influence and constrain decision and actions within the individual firm. Consideration of these forces as features of the existing legal, social, and ethical environments. Specific topics include the legal system and public policy, social organization, moral and ethical standards, public opinion, the social responsibility of the firm, and conception within the firm of its role in society, and the interaction of these forces with economic forces.
MGMT 774.subject: MGMT
MGMT 774.title: The Firm and Its Environment

MGMT 775.description: Analyzing emerging technologies and applying strategic innovation frameworks for stakeholders in competitive environments with a multi-disciplinary team.
MGMT 775.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MGMT 733 or MGMT 776.
MGMT 775.subject: MGMT
MGMT 775.title: Strategic Analysis and Application of Innovation

MGMT 776.description: An evaluation of strategic planning and processes in converging industries. Emphasis on underlying scientific, innovation, and technological concepts.
MGMT 776.subject: MGMT
MGMT 776.title: Strategic Innovation Planning and Processes

MGMT 777.description: Examines the principles, tools, and techniques necessary to conceptualize and initiate a new business entity.
MGMT 777.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ACCT 725, DMSB 710, or ACCT 728.
MGMT 777.subject: MGMT
MGMT 777.title: Innovation and New Venture Analysis

MGMT 778.description: An examination of problems involved in the organization and management of a small business, including an analysis of legal forms, location, product market determination, production, and other operating conditions.
MGMT 778.subject: MGMT
MGMT 778.title: Small Business Management

MGMT 779.description: Orientation to the field of personnel and employment relations. Also provides training in communications and computer skills needed in managing human resources.
MGMT 779.subject: MGMT
MGMT 779.title: Personnel and Employment Relations

MGMT 780.description: Exploration of the funding and financial management of emerging ventures, including sources and structure of capital, financial levers to drive performance and metrics to monitor performance, and the study of how to impact, capture, quantify and realize value.
MGMT 780.subject: MGMT
MGMT 780.title: Entrepreneurial Finance and the Dynamics of Emerging Ventures

MGMT 782.description: Chronological view of career development issues, from initial vocational and job choice decisions through retirement. Short-run and long-term consequences of individual and organizational career development strategies.
MGMT 782.subject: MGMT
MGMT 782.title: Managing Careers in Organizations

MGMT 790.description: Research tools, techniques, and sources are utilized in the development of both analytical ability and facility in communication.
MGMT 790.subject: MGMT
MGMT 790.title: Business Research and Reports

MGMT 820.description: Emphasis on development of understanding the history of management theory and examination of current interpretations of these concepts.
MGMT 820.subject: MGMT
MGMT 820.title: Foundations of Management Theory

MGMT 821.description: Study of major theoretical and methodological issues in organizational behavior with emphasis on developing conceptual models and implementing research designs.
MGMT 821.subject: MGMT
MGMT 821.title: Doctoral Seminar in the Behavioral Sciences I

MGMT 822.description: Exploration of current specialized topics in organizational behavior with emphasis on synthesizing research, developing conceptual models, and implementing research designs.
MGMT 822.subject: MGMT
MGMT 822.title: Doctoral Seminar in the Behavioral Sciences II

MGMT 823.description: An advanced seminar focusing upon reading, synthesis, and critical evaluation of current research in business and management.
MGMT 823.subject: MGMT
MGMT 823.title: Current Topics in the Organization Sciences

MGMT 824.description: Theories and research in human resource management.
MGMT 824.subject: MGMT
MGMT 824.title: Doctoral Seminar in Human Resource Management I

MGMT 825.description: Advanced theories and research in human resource management.
MGMT 825.subject: MGMT
MGMT 825.title: Doctoral Seminar in Human Resource Management II

MGMT 828.description: Theories and research in entrepreneurship, emphasizing strategic management framework in integrating diverse treatments of the entrepreneur, new ventures, and corporate innovation.
MGMT 828.subject: MGMT
MGMT 828.title: Seminar in Entrepreneurship

MGMT 871.description: An evaluation of theories of organization, with particular emphasis on business applications. Approaches to a conceptual framework include decision theory, sociological and behavioral theories. Various models are evaluated in an attempt to build a framework for analysis of organizations.
MGMT 871.subject: MGMT
MGMT 871.title: Organization Theory

MGMT 872.description: Research methods and techniques for translation of management theory and practical problems into testable propositions.
MGMT 872.subject: MGMT
MGMT 872.title: Seminar in Management Research Methodology

MGMT 878.description: Investigates the theoretical and empirical evidence regarding strategies aimed at creating and sustaining competitive superiority in business firms and the strategy formation process.
MGMT 878.subject: MGMT
MGMT 878.title: Seminar in Strategy Formulation

MGMT 879.description: Continuation of MGMT 878 , with emphasis on strategy implementation.
MGMT 879.subject: MGMT
MGMT 879.title: Seminar in Strategy Implementation

MGMT 882.description: The development and application of advanced statistical methods to problems in business and economics. Topics include application of estimation and hypothesis testing in both univariate and multivariate cases.
MGMT 882.subject: MGMT
MGMT 882.title: Advanced Statistics for Business I

MGMT 892.description: The structure and analysis of experimental and research designs with applications to business problems.
MGMT 892.subject: MGMT
MGMT 892.title: Advanced Statistics for Business II
